_comment: Edit the owner/repo, bundle IDs, icons, and descriptions. The generator reads the LATEST release of each repo and picks one iOS IPA (any .ipa not containing 'vision'/'xros') and one visionOS IPA (name contains 'vision' or 'xros').

ios.name: Quake Ports — iPhone & iPad
ios.subtitle: Quake 1, 2, 3, 4, natively on iOS
ios.description: Pristine iOS ports of Quake, Quake II, Quake III Arena, and Quake 4. Bring your own game data.

visionos.name: Quake Ports — Apple Vision Pro
visionos.subtitle: Quake 1, 2, 3, 4 in 2D and stereoscopic 3D
visionos.description: Pristine Apple Vision Pro ports of Quake, Quake II, Quake III Arena, and Quake 4, with a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode. Bring your own game data.

apps.name: Quake
apps.subtitle: Quake for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The full Quake campaign, mission packs, QuakeC mods, and — on Apple Vision Pro — a stereoscopic 3D mode. Built on vkQuake. Ships with no game content; you supply your own Quake files.

apps.name: q2repro
apps.subtitle: Quake II for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: Quake II, including the re-release content, with an Apple Vision Pro 3D mode. Built on q2repro. Bring your own Quake II game data.

apps.name: Quake III Arena
apps.subtitle: Quake III Arena for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: Quake III Arena with bots and multiplayer, plus an Apple Vision Pro 3D mode. Built on quake3e. Bring your own Quake III game data.

apps.name: openQ4
apps.subtitle: Quake 4 for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: Quake 4 running natively on iPhone and Apple Vision Pro through openQ4, the open-source replacement for the Quake 4 engine and game code — its Vulkan renderer on Metal via MoltenVK. The full story campaign with saves, openQ4's offline Arena Campaign against bots, touch-usable in-world screens, controllers with rumble, touch sticks and gyro aim, EFX reverb, demos, data-only mods, and multiplayer between openQ4 players. On Apple Vision Pro there is a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode with foveated rendering. Ships with no game content — you supply your own Quake 4 (q4base, patched to 1.4.2; Steam and GOG already are). The game modules remain under id Software's Quake 4 SDK EULA: free and non-commercial only.
